parameters.query:
-- Get pending handoff requests with user context
SELECT 
  hr.id,
  hr.phone_number,
  hr.reason,
  hr.priority,
  hr.conversation_context,
  hr.sentiment_score,
  hr.created_at,
  u.contact_name,
  u.language_preference,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - hr.created_at)) as wait_time_seconds
FROM handoff_requests hr
LEFT JOIN users u ON hr.phone_number = u.phone_number
WHERE hr.status = 'pending'
ORDER BY 
  CASE hr.priority 
    WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1
    WHEN 'high' THEN 2
    WHEN 'medium' THEN 3
    WHEN 'low' THEN 4
  END,
  hr.created_at ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- Find best available agent
WITH available_agents AS (
  SELECT 
    agent_id,
    agent_name,
    email,
    slack_user_id,
    status,
    current_chat_count,
    max_concurrent_chats,
    skills,
    languages,
    (max_concurrent_chats - current_chat_count) as capacity,
    last_seen_at
  FROM agent_availability
  WHERE status = 'online'
    AND current_chat_count < max_concurrent_chats
    AND last_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
)
SELECT *
FROM available_agents
WHERE 
  -- Match skills if required skills provided
  CASE 
    WHEN $1::text[] IS NOT NULL THEN 
      skills && $1::text[]
    ELSE TRUE
  END
ORDER BY 
  capacity DESC,
  current_chat_count ASC,
  last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Update handoff request with assigned agent
UPDATE handoff_requests
SET 
  status = 'assigned',
  assigned_to = $1,
  assigned_at = NOW(),
  wait_time_seconds = $2
WHERE id = $3
RETURNING *;

-- Create active handoff session
INSERT INTO active_handoffs (
  id,
  handoff_request_id,
  phone_number,
  agent_id,
  channel,
  slack_channel_id,
  conversation_messages,
  status,
  started_at,
  last_message_at
)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  'slack',
  NULL,
  '[]'::jsonb,
  'active',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *;

-- Increment agent's current chat count
UPDATE agent_availability
SET 
  current_chat_count = current_chat_count + 1,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE agent_id = $1
RETURNING *;

-- Log successful handoff
INSERT INTO analytics (phone_number, event_type, event_data, timestamp)
VALUES (
  $1,
  'handoff_assigned',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'handoff_id', $2,
    'agent_id', $3,
    'reason', $4,
    'priority', $5,
    'wait_time_seconds', $6
  ),
  NOW()
);

-- Mark handoff as failed if no agent available
UPDATE handoff_requests
SET 
  status = 'pending',
  metadata = jsonb_build_object(
    'no_agent_available', true,
    'retry_count', COALESCE((metadata->>'retry_count')::int, 0) + 1,
    'last_retry_at', NOW()
  )
WHERE id = $1;

-- Log error for no available agent
INSERT INTO error_logs (
  phone_number,
  error_type,
  error_message,
  severity,
  context,
  timestamp
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  'no_agent_available',
  'No agent available for handoff request',
  'warning',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'handoff_id', $2,
    'reason', $3,
    'priority', $4,
    'retry_count', COALESCE((SELECT metadata->>'retry_count' FROM handoff_requests WHERE id = $2)::int, 1)
  ),
  NOW()
);
